title: Reporting requirements; non-federally regulated appraisal management companies.
bodyText: The director shall collect from each appraisal management company registered or seeking registration in the State all information and fees required by the Appraisal Subcommittee to be submitted to the Appraisal Subcommittee by the State, pursuant to regulations or guidance promulgated by the Appraisal Subcommittee.
bodyHtml: [§466M-13]  Reporting requirements; non-federally regulated appraisal management companies.  The director shall collect from each appraisal management company registered or seeking registration in the State all information and fees required by the Appraisal Subcommittee to be submitted to the Appraisal Subcommittee by the State, pursuant to regulations or guidance promulgated by the Appraisal Subcommittee. [L 2024, c 80, pt of §2]
